note: Forge 2.0.14 engine facts (CubeLab.java facts, cached) for the Synergy v3 study's 17 card-flow cards and controls that are not card flow (D446 point 5)

flow.name: Consider
flow.oracle: Surveil 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put that card into your graveyard.)\nDraw a card.

flow.name: Brainstorm
flow.oracle: Draw three cards, then put two cards from your hand on top of your library in any order.

flow.name: Ponder
flow.oracle: Look at the top three cards of your library, then put them back in any order. You may shuffle.\nDraw a card.

flow.name: Thought Scour
flow.oracle: Target player mills two cards.\nDraw a card.

flow.name: Deep Analysis
flow.oracle: Target player draws two cards.\nFlashback—{1}{U}, Pay 3 life. (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.)

flow.name: Mulldrifter
flow.oracle: Flying\nWhen Mulldrifter enters, draw two cards.\nEvoke {2}{U} (You may cast this spell for its evoke cost. If you do, it's sacrificed when it enters.)

flow.name: Faithless Looting
flow.oracle: Draw two cards, then discard two cards.\nFlashback {2}{R} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.)

flow.name: Cathartic Reunion
flow.oracle: As an additional cost to cast this spell, discard two cards.\nDraw three cards.

flow.name: Unexpected Windfall
flow.oracle: As an additional cost to cast this spell, discard a card.\nDraw two cards and create two Treasure tokens. (They're artifacts with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color.")

flow.name: Mishra's Bauble
flow.oracle: {T}, Sacrifice Mishra's Bauble: Look at the top card of target player's library. Draw a card at the beginning of the next turn's upkeep.

flow.name: Chromatic Star
flow.oracle: {1}, {T}, Sacrifice Chromatic Star: Add one mana of any color.\nWhen Chromatic Star is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, draw a card.

flow.name: Prophetic Prism
flow.oracle: When Prophetic Prism enters, draw a card.\n{1}, {T}: Add one mana of any color.

flow.name: Ichor Wellspring
flow.oracle: When Ichor Wellspring enters or is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, draw a card.

flow.name: Candy Trail
flow.oracle: When Candy Trail enters, scry 2.\n{2}, {T}, Sacrifice Candy Trail: You gain 3 life and draw a card.

flow.name: Village Rites
flow.oracle: As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature.\nDraw two cards.

flow.name: Deadly Dispute
flow.oracle: As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice an artifact or creature.\nDraw two cards and create a Treasure token. (It's an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color.")

control.name: Lightning Bolt
control.oracle: Lightning Bolt deals 3 damage to any target.

control.name: Remand
control.oracle: Counter target spell. If that spell is countered this way, put it into its owner's hand instead of into that player's graveyard.\nDraw a card.

control.name: Repulse
control.oracle: Return target creature to its owner's hand.\nDraw a card.

control.name: Exclude
control.oracle: Counter target creature spell.\nDraw a card.

control.name: Mind Stone
control.oracle: {T}: Add {C}.\n{1}, {T}, Sacrifice Mind Stone: Draw a card.

control.name: Miscalculation
control.oracle: Counter target spell unless its controller pays {2}.\nCycling {2} ({2}, Discard this card: Draw a card.)

control.name: Archmage's Charm
control.oracle:
Choose one —
• Counter target spell.
• Target player draws two cards.
• Gain control of target nonland permanent with mana value 1 or less.

control.name: Howling Mine
control.oracle: At the beginning of each player's draw step, if Howling Mine is untapped, that player draws an additional card.

control.name: Fact or Fiction
control.oracle: Reveal the top five cards of your library. An opponent separates those cards into two piles. Put one pile into your hand and the other into your graveyard.

control.name: Phyrexian Arena
control.oracle: At the beginning of your upkeep, you draw a card and you lose 1 life.

control.name: Skullclamp
control.oracle: Equipped creature gets +1/-1.\nWhenever equipped creature dies, draw two cards.\nEquip {1}

control.name: Cryptic Command
control.oracle:
Choose two —
• Counter target spell.
• Return target permanent to its owner's hand.
• Tap all creatures your opponents control.
• Draw a card.

control.name: Fire // Ice
control.oracle:
Fire deals 2 damage divided as you choose among one or two targets.

Tap target permanent.\nDraw a card.

control.name: Bitterblossom
control.oracle: At the beginning of your upkeep, you lose 1 life and create a 1/1 black Faerie Rogue creature token with flying.

control.name: Sylvan Library
control.oracle: At the beginning of your draw step, you may draw two additional cards. If you do, choose two cards in your hand drawn this turn. For each of those cards, pay 4 life or put the card on top of your library.
